fields.label: Device PIN / User ID
fields.description: The employee ID as stored on the device (PIN for ZKTeco, user_id for EBKN)

fields.label: Name on Device
fields.description: The name the user was given on the biometric device. Reported by the device itself; this is not the ERP employee name.

fields.label: Employee
fields.description: Derived from the Employee whose Attendance Device ID is this PIN, which is what the check-in lookup reads. Set or clear the PIN on the Employee.

fields.label: Allow in All Devices
fields.description: If checked, this user is enrolled on all active devices of each brand

fields.label: ZKTeco Template
fields.description: Private file containing the user's fingerprint template for ZKTeco devices

fields.label: EBKN Template
fields.description: Private file containing the user's enrollment blob for EBKN devices

fields.label: Device Privilege
fields.options:
Normal User
Enroller
Admin
Super Admin
fields.description: Rights this user has ON the device keypad/menu. Pushed with every user sync, so an admin is never silently demoted. Normal User = clock in/out only.

fields.label: Device Password
fields.description: Numeric code this user can type on the device keypad (PIN + password) as an alternative to their fingerprint. Pushed with every user sync so it is not wiped. Leave blank for none.
